tenantInput.description: Canonical GUID or demo domain. Demo-user email input is reduced to its onmicrosoft.com domain before saving; this does not verify tenant identity.

integrationMode.description: create stores admin-led setup intent; existing uses a pre-provisioned account. Missing field on old profiles means existing.

bootstrapMode.description: Explicit provisioning credential: pre-created configured Machine with verified admin role, or separately configured admin API account. Legacy configs retain admin; new form entries recommend machine. Never grants privileges.

manualPeople.description: User-declared Microsoft identities and intended ServiceNow handling. Not verified accounts and never automatic source-write approval.

email.description: Single canonical email required in both Microsoft and ServiceNow. The ServiceNow login may differ, but existing source email mismatches must block reuse/creation until explicitly corrected. This saved value is not proof of source equality.

serviceNowUserName.description: Exact ServiceNow login, normally firstname.lastname, separate from the shared email. New form entries suggest it from the name; explicit and saved values are preserved.

roleProfiles.description: Explicitly selected planned roles only. Admin means full ServiceNow instance administration and always requires separate source-change approval; saving never grants it.
